prompt.project_info: Create a high-resolution social-media gym portrait of an approved adult male athlete seated on stacked barbell plates in an industrial CrossFit facility.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult man with messy blonde hair and a neutral expression, wearing a black-and-white plaid flannel over a white tank top, white compression shorts, and white crew socks. He sits on black weight plates and makes a peace sign.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium portrait with the seated subject centered in the gym. Include chalkboard workout scores, wooden Rogue plyo boxes, rubber flooring, dumbbells, and industrial fans; preserve visible brand text only when supplied as a typography reference.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright overhead gym lighting, realistic skin and fabric texture, casual confident training atmosphere, natural social-media documentary feel.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution digital photography, vertical portrait framing, sharp subject, realistic anatomy and hands, natural contrast and fine detail.
